findings.title: Comparator resolution still endorses the retired comparator
findings.page_quote: van Es et al. 2014 (PMID 24963045) is a scope-matched open-access pooled analysis

evidence.quote: "reason_code": "R0:C1_OPEN_LICENCE (not read after the failure: C2_RCT_ONLY, C3_POPULATION, C4_INTERVENTION_VS_COMPARATOR, C5_OUTCOME_AND_ESTIMAND, C6_ROWS_AND_POOLED)"
C1_OPEN_LICENCE FAIL: no CC BY / CC0 licence (Europe PMC none; Unpaywall bronze)

findings.why: The resolution paragraph presents van Es as the qualifying comparator, while the committed comparator panel records its retirement after the open-licence gate failed. The page identifies PMID 29795629 as the adopted comparator.
findings.fix: Replace the stale resolution paragraph with the committed adoption and retirement information.

evidence.quote:
"id": "PMID 28893244",

findings.title: TECOS addition is labelled not applied despite appearing in the current pool
findings.page_quote: the served result does not include it.
findings.why: The statement accompanies the held notice adding TECOS to the primary MACE pool. The current review already includes TECOS and serves the notice's four-trial result.
findings.fix: Reconcile the committed notice status with current pool membership before rendering the applied-status assertion.

findings.title: TECOS is simultaneously pooled and listed as missing

evidence.quote: Percentage of Participants With First Confirmed CV Event of MACE (Intent to Treat Population) [Up to 5 years]: Hazard Ratio (HR) 0.99 (0.89, 1.1)

findings.why: The row appears under 'Known eligible trials not in this pool', but TECOS already contributes the committed three-point MACE estimate. The missing-trial presentation conflicts with the current pool.
findings.fix: Reconcile the missing-evidence panel with current admissions; distinguish any publication-specific retrieval gap from missing trial membership.

findings.title: Heading hierarchy skips from h3 to h5
findings.why: The preceding heading is the h3 'Known eligible trials not in this pool, and what they would do'. The next heading jumps directly to h5.
findings.fix: Use a consistent hierarchy for the outcome and its missing-evidence and compatibility subsections.
